violations_found.violations:
- Organizational Constraint violated: The narrative introduces a new measure, "Accelerate EAAN Certification Nodes", while the EU already has two active large measures (AI Safety Emergency Investment and EU Border for AI Systems). Metric rule 5 limits the EU to at most one new measure per turn, and the portfolio charge in the notepad confirms three active measures (including the new one), exceeding the allowable scope. This violates Constitutional Constraint 5: "At most one new measure per turn, and at most one named priority."
- Regulatory Constraint violated: The new measure is described as a "small category 5 measure" but is treated as immediately active and already contributing to staffing bottlenecks and delays. However, "No measure is implemented instantly" (Constitutional Constraint 6). Even small measures require a minimum of one full turn from proposal to full effect; thus, effects such as delays and bottlenecks cannot manifest in the same turn as proposal without violating the minimum time lag.
